payload.friendly_name: Retire Vikunja felix-bot: single kent-token model
payload.purpose_context: Felix's runtime defaults to the felix-bot Vikunja token, which cannot see the topic-projects #717 created as kent (projects 16-20, ~30+ tasks) and never shared, so scans and the dedup precheck operate on a partial view. This mission drops the agent-attribution two-token model, switches all runtime consumers to the kent token via the single client default, collapses the registry/validator to one token, records the decision in ADR-0003, and retires the felix-bot credential from the manifest (leaving the token valid for rollback and the felix-bot user dormant), deploying with before/after connectivity verification.
payload.purpose_tldr: Retire the Vikunja felix-bot token and route all Felix to Vikunja access through the single kent token, so Felix sees Kent's full task store.
